description: The BLACK+DECKER Matrix 6 Tool Combo Set (BDCDMT1206KITC) is an all-in-one kit to tackle most jobs around the house. The 20V max motor provides enough power for a variety of applications and the 20V max lithium-ion battery lasts a charge up to 18 months, so it's ready when you need it. The innovative Matrix Quick Connect system allows quick and easy change of all included attachments. The drill attachment includes a 3/8 inch chuck and 11 adjustable clutch settings to deliver the right torque for the correct application. The impact wrench attachment delivers high performance without kickback, along with a variable speed function that allows precise performance that's right for any job. The sanding attachment is a versatile product that can be used for final grinding, rust removal, dry scrubbing, polishing and detail sanding. The jigsaw attachment is designed for tool-free blade changes for quick and easy blade change. The router bit delivers high speeds for fast trimming and decorative woodwork. The oscillating attachment accepts a variety of BLACK+DECKER accessories that can be used to cut drywall, metal, wood, plastic, composites and many other materials. Includes mounting hardware: (1) BDCMTDD drill/screwdriver attachment, (1) BDCMTS detail sander attachment, (1) BDCMTJS jigsaw attachment, (1) BDCMTO oscillating attachment, (1) BDCMTI impact driver attachment, and (1) BDCMTR router attachment.
